title: Three-Day Enduro Tour of Dalat and Nha Trang
description: Enduro tour Dalat to Nha Trang: 3 days of wild off-road through mountain ranges and pine forests. Powerful bikes, secret locations, and pure adrenaline. Click to explore!

Booking confirmation: record at least 2 days in advance. The organizer will confirm the booking for the date you have chosen, after which you will make a 30% prepayment.
Three-Day Enduro Tour of Dalat and Nha Trang
Three-Day Tour of Dalat and Nha Trang

Experience the thrill of an enduro tour in Da Nang, exploring stunning landscapes where mountains meet the sea. Ride through dense tropical forests on challenging red clay trails and rocky climbs. Enjoy breathtaking views of Danang Bay from high vantage points. Navigate abandoned military roads and local paths for an authentic experience. This adventure combines adrenaline, technical riding, and coastal beauty in just a few hours.
Honda CRF 250, Suzuki DRZ 400, Honda XR230, Honda XR150
Three-Day Enduro Tour of Dalat and Nha Trang
Ride powerful bikes for a cool trip.
Exciting and picturesque off-roading: pine forests and cliffs.
Swimming in secret waterfalls and mountain rivers.
Embark on a journey through wild, non-touristic places.
Special impressions from the speed and freedom of the roads.
Honda CRF 250, Suzuki DRZ 400, Honda XR230, Honda XR150

The surroundings of Da Lat are so diverse that one day is simply not enough to see everything. No matter which direction you go, you'll find panoramic hard tracks, cliffs, and mirror-like lakes. We've combined the best locations into a two-day itinerary, starting with the famous Suoi Vang Lake and ending with the remote Tam Tam Waterfall, hidden deep within the pine forests.

You'll navigate through coffee and strawberry plantations, tackling steep inclines and challenging terrains that are physically impossible to cover in a single day. This is a full immersion in the wild nature of the highlands: a rush, absolute freedom, and honest extreme. This adventure happens once in a lifetime — book your spot and get the most out of your time in Vietnam!

Introduction and equipment We meet you in the cafe at the bottom of our house, get to know each other and go up to the apartment. While we pick up the equipment and dress, we discuss your experience (where and how often you have ridden). Based on this, we select the difficulty of the route: we train beginners on the lai, experienced riders are immediately taken to the average difficulty.

Includes: Transfer to the starting point, detailed instructions, and a trial run. Here, you learn how to operate the equipment under the supervision of the guides and take your first confident steps (or runs) before entering the main track.

We set a time limit and set out on the route. The guide does not stray more than 150 meters, waiting for all participants in the shade or on flat areas. During the tour, we provide advice, encourage participants at difficult stages, and take photos/videos at all viewing points.
Includes: A snack on the route and a return to the base. The final stage, where you can rest, share your impressions over a snack, and return to the collection point in comfort.
We can customize a tour based on your preferences and desired dates. Just let us know your requirements, and we will create a personalized tour for you.
The tour price does not include transportation, airfare, or airport transfers, but we can arrange these services at an additional cost if needed.
We also have other larger bikes available for your trips. Please contact us for more information.
The tour price may vary depending on the low/high tourist season or other special requests. Please contact us to get the exact price for your tour.
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN THE PACKAGE
High-quality Honda XR150L/Honda XR230L/Yamaha WR 155 motorcycle or other motorcycle with a full fuel kit.
The tour price includes meals (1 lunch with local Vietnamese cuisine).
Bike damage (In case of damage caused by the driver, the renter is responsible for repairs and restoration)
Your booking is confirmed after receiving the prepayment. For guaranteed booking, we ask for a small prepayment, usually 30% of the total tour price.
The balance is paid before the tour starts.
To participate in the tour, you must pay a deposit of $200 or provide an original passport.
Acceptance without waiting: To save you time after the tour, we do not require you to wait for the inspection at the point.
You can relax while we take the motorcycle to the service center for inspection.
Return: If the motorcycle is in good condition, we will bring your deposit or passport to any location in the city at a convenient time.
If any damage is caused by the driver, the cost of repairs will be deducted from the deposit.
To drive legally and have insurance coverage, you must carry
issued in accordance with the 1968 Vienna Convention.
Only a car license or another type of ID card is valid.
The absence of the necessary documents invalidates your travel insurance and leads to fines.
Enduro Vietnam only allows participants with driving skills and good health to join the tours.
The deposit is not refundable, but you can reschedule your reservation for a different time.
Refunds are not available in case of adverse weather conditions or customer error. The tour may be delayed due to adverse weather conditions, but we are not responsible for cancellations.

If your motorcycle malfunctions due to technical issues, we will replace it with a similar model, and our guide will attempt to repair it during the day. Your tour may be shortened due to technical reasons. You will be refunded for the day that you are unable to complete.

If you need to cancel your reservation, you can reschedule it or transfer it to another person. Please note that you will be responsible for any associated administrative costs, and you must ensure that your designated representative pays the full amount.
